name: Three.js
role: Browser 3D rendered once per seek with alpha: product shots, hero objects, camera moves
summary: The standard WebGL and WebGPU scene graph for the browser, with loaders, PBR materials, lights, shadows, postprocessing and a shading language. In VCR a scene renders once per requested time with a transparent clear colour, so 3D layers can composite over anything else (alpha is not yet asserted by a retained check). Real-time quality in seconds per shot rather than Blender's minutes.
use_when: Product reveals, floating objects and camera orbits that must turn around fast
Over Babylon.js for the larger ecosystem: pmndrs postprocessing, drei, glTF tooling
Over Blender when real-time PBR is enough and the source should stay web-native
Shader-driven visuals through TSL or raw GLSL
avoid_when: Path-traced quality or the compositor: Blender
Step-by-step physics or fluids: Blender caches, or Rapier with fixed-step replay
Mostly 2D with incidental depth: p5.js or PixiJS
React is already the app shell: React Three Fiber on top

facets.one_line: Renderer with alpha, cameras as functions of t, render on the driven frame
glTF and textures loaded before the scene declares itself ready
Standard and physical materials, environment lighting, shadows
Composer passes and which effects are seek-safe
Node materials in JavaScript for the WebGPU renderer

evidence.result: 90 alpha frames at 1280x720; shuffled order matches sequential
